body.name: Nested-survivor chain flow
body.construction: On \(\mathcal G_m\), inject each treated-readmission mass at a chain source indexed by \(j\); send chain flow across death cut \(k\) with capacity \(\kappa^x_{kj}\); allow exit \(f^x_{ij}\) to control-death demand \(i\); impose \(\sum_j f^x_{ij}=d_x(i)\) and \(\sum_i f^x_{ij}=\zeta_x(j)\).
